_comment: ADR-023 THE FOSSIL LAW, file level. Orphaned .uid/.import sidecars whose source is gone, keyed by repo-relative path. THIS LIST ONLY SHRINKS. 'count' and 'ceiling' are the ratchet's witnesses: the probe FAILS if either disagrees with 'orphans', so a hand-edit cannot pass quietly. --write-baseline can only ever remove entries. New entries enter ONLY via --grandfather --reason=<text>.
